question: What division of eight octads is sought to be known completely?
premises: A division consisting of eight octads is mentioned.
Complete knowledge of this division is desired.
The knowing is described as extending endlessly.
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and without limit the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: anantathā may qualify the extent of the division or the manner of knowing.
plain_english: And I wish to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
